info.name: HackYeah 2026 API
info.description: Requests for the HackYeah 2026 backend. Run folders in order (0 → 4): later requests use ids and tokens saved by earlier ones. See postman/README.md.

exec: // Auto dev-login (needs AUTH_DEV_LOGIN=true on the backend). Set `autoLogin` to "off" to manage tokens yourself.
body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify({ name: u.name, role: u.role }) },
"Is the backend running with AUTH_DEV_LOGIN=true in .env?");
console.warn("Got 401 – tokens cleared, the next request logs in again. Re-send this one.");

item.name: 0. Auth
item.description: You don't have to run these: the collection logs in automatically before any request (anna = user, bartek = second user, boss = admin; needs AUTH_DEV_LOGIN=true). These requests do the same explicitly. For a real OAuth login set `autoLogin` to `off`, open {{baseUrl}}/auth/github/login in a browser and paste access_token into the `token` variable.

request.description: Shows the redirect to GitHub. For a real login open {{baseUrl}}/auth/github/login in a browser, log in and copy access_token from the JSON into the `token` variable.
Same as GitHub: open {{baseUrl}}/auth/google/login in a browser.
